title: Latency guardrails matrix: per-endpoint/model/region p95/p99 dashboards and bench harness
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Add a cross-cutting latency guardrails matrix that tracks p95 and p99 latencies and tokens/sec by route, model variant, and region, plus a reproducible bench harness that can replay representative traffic and surface regressions. This ticket covers: 1) telemetry schema and enrichment for attaching route+model+region tags to quantile emits, 2) dashboard design for matrix slices and drilldowns, 3) load harness integration that can run both synthetic and sampled production traffic, and 4) regression detection rules and alerting playbook. We will prioritize low-risk instrumentation, avoid adding high-cardinality tags to core RPCs, and support rollouts via feature flags.
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry emits consistent p95/p99 and tokens_per_sec metrics with route/model/region tags for at least 90% of production routes
Matrix dashboard in Console that shows sortable p95/p99 and tokens/sec rows, with clickable drilldowns to historical trends and raw traces
Bench harness able to run reproducible workloads (unit of work: request+token distribution) and produce a baseline artifact stored in S3/Blob with latency quantiles
Regression detector that compares latest bench run vs baseline and opens an alert (Slack + PagerDuty) when p95 regresses by >15% or p99 by >20% on high-traffic routes
Runbook documenting how to interpret matrix, validate false positives, and roll back model variants or routing policies
implementation_notes: Telemetry: add an intermediate aggregator that buckets per-request latency samples into quantile sketch per minute and emits p50/p75/p95/p99 and tokens/sec. Use existing metrics pipeline (statsd -> metric-ingestor) and extend the schema to include 'route','model_variant','region' tags. Dashboard: build a matrix view that pages results by region and supports filtering by SLO class. Bench harness: extend inferbench with a 'matrix profile' runner that can (a) replay sampled production traces with preserved token length distribution and (b) run synthetic prompt families. Store output artifacts and latency fingerprints. Regression detection: nightly baseline jobs plus on-demand run; use bootstrap confidence intervals and require at least 2000 requests per slice to alert. Avoid high-cardinality joins in live dashboards by capping model_variant label to 'canonical' or 'fallback' mappings.
risks_mitigations: High cardinaility of model_variant leading to heavy metrics cardinality -> mitigation: rollup mapping table and tag normalization
False positives from bursty traffic -> mitigation: use sliding-window baselines and require sustained regression over 3 consecutive runs
Bench harness causing extra load in production -> mitigation: run sampled replays on replica clusters or during low-traffic windows and provide opt-in toggles for customers
